WITH ratios AS (
    SELECT p.SEX, l.CPK * 1.0 / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.CPK IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT <> 0
), sex_averages AS (
    SELECT SEX, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM ratios
    GROUP BY SEX
), first_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_avg
    FROM sex_averages
), first_kept AS (
    SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_ratio, f.mean_avg
    FROM sex_averages AS s
    CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f
    WHERE s.avg_ratio > f.mean_avg
), second_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_avg
    FROM first_kept
), final_kept AS (
    SELECT k.avg_ratio, k.mean_avg AS first_mean, m.mean_avg AS second_mean
    FROM first_kept AS k
    CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m
    WHERE k.avg_ratio > m.mean_avg
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_ratio,
       AVG(avg_ratio - first_mean) AS average_above_first_mean,
       AVG(avg_ratio - second_mean) AS average_above_second_mean
FROM final_kept;
